name: scroll-island
blurb: Floating progress indicator that shows scroll depth and collapses on scroll pause.
description: Fixed-position floating island that displays scroll progress as a circular indicator and auto-collapses after scroll stops. Detects dark mode, respects user scroll position, and can display child content when expanded.
use_when: Long-form content pages (docs, articles, guides) where showing reading progress improves user orientation without cluttering the viewport.
avoid_when: Short pages or when scroll indicators add visual noise. Not suitable for pages with poor vertical navigation.
a11y: No ARIA attributes or keyboard interaction. Visual-only indicator; does not expose progress to screen readers.
